Definition: perhaps from the same as G1966; tomorrow's; but more probably from G1909 and a derivative of the present participle feminine of G1510; for subsistence, i.e. needful:--daily.
BiblicalUsage: Epiousios is the word for daily bread — tomorrow's bread, or bread for the coming day, in the prayer Jesus taught. Give us this day our daily bread.
TheologicalSignificance: Enough for today, asked for today, from the Father who gives today: daily bread is the whole of trust in one phrase.
